toolkits.title: Gmail
toolkits.access: Doddy can list your recent emails (sender, subject, a short preview) and create drafts after you tap Create. Doddy never sends, deletes or labels email. Google's draft permission also allows sending; Doddy has no send tool.

tools.name: check_email
tools.title: Check my email
tools.blurb: Lists your newest emails: sender, subject and a short preview. Doddy doesn't open full messages.

tools.name: draft_email
tools.title: Draft an email
tools.blurb: Creates a draft in Gmail after you tap Create on the card. Doddy never sends it.

toolkits.title: Google Drive
toolkits.access: Doddy can find files by name (name, type, last change). It can't open, change, share or delete files.

tools.name: find_drive_file
tools.title: Find a Drive file
tools.blurb: Looks up files by name and shows name, type and last change. It can't open or change files.

toolkits.title: Notion
toolkits.access: Doddy can search the titles of pages you shared with it. It doesn't read page content and can't change anything.

tools.name: search_notion
tools.title: Search Notion
tools.blurb: Finds page titles shared with Doddy. It doesn't read the pages.

toolkits.title: Todoist
toolkits.access: Doddy can list your open tasks and add a task after you tap Add. It can't complete, change or delete tasks.

tools.name: list_todoist_tasks
tools.title: List my tasks
tools.blurb: Lists your open Todoist tasks, for example what's due today.

tools.name: add_todoist_task
tools.title: Add a task
tools.blurb: Adds a Todoist task after you tap Add on the card.

toolkits.title: Web search
toolkits.access: Doddy can look things up on the web when you ask: your search words go to Doddy's server and on to a search provider through Monid. No sign-in. Doddy pays for searches and there's a daily limit.

tools.name: web_search
tools.title: Search the web
tools.blurb: Looks up current information (opening hours, news, prices) and tells you where it came from.
